headline: Chinese hackers used AI to breach ConnectWise customers
summary: Microsoft said China-aligned hackers breached ConnectWise and used AI agents to quickly gain privileged access, in some cases within three hours, spying on thousands of the IT giant's customers and cloud tenants.

claims.statement: Microsoft said Chinese-linked hackers breached ConnectWise and used that access to spy on thousands of customers.

sources.quote: Microsoft says ConnectWise breach let Chinese spies loose on 2,250 cloud tenants
Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker

claims.statement: The attackers relied on AI agents to carry out the intrusion quickly.

sources.quote: AI agents did the dirty work
relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers

claims.statement: In some environments, the attackers gained privileged access in under three hours.

sources.quote: hackers gaining privileged access in some environments in under three hours
